observations: Black game console with a split design, characteristic of the PS4 Fat model.
Two controllers are shown: one standard black and one custom-colored with blue, red, and black splatter decals.
A UK-style 3-pin power plug is visible in all photos.
The console has visible scuffs and scratches on the top surface.
A small piece of paper is tucked between the controllers in photos 0 and 1.

claims.evidence: No storage label or model plate is visible in the photos.
No video or audio output is shown; the console is not powered on.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The internal storage may be smaller than claimed (e.g., 500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' settings screen in the system menu.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of both controllers being used to navigate the menu.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the console connected to a TV showing a game title screen.
Photo of the 'Storage' settings screen showing the total capacity.
Video of both controllers being used to navigate the system menu.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
